name: Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of crystal-related products in Japan, China, the United States, Germany, South Korea, Mexico, Romania, and internationally. The company also offers crystal units, crystal oscillators, frequency synthesizers, signal generators, millimeter-wave converters, synthetic quartz crystals, optical components, QCM outgas analysis system and real-time process monitor, outgas analysis systems, ultrasonic transducers, and SAW devices. ts products are used in various applications, space, infrastructure/industrial equipment, automotive, mobile, AV/OA, medical, healthcare, household appliance, and connectivity sectors.
